intro.text: Meridian Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: MRDN), headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, is an established B2B and B2C gaming technology group operating across 20+ international regulated markets. The Company’s B2C division is led by Meridianbet Group, a leading online sports betting and gaming operator founded in 2001 and licensed across Europe, Africa, and South America. Meridian’s B2B division - comprising game developer Expanse Studios and iGaming platform GMAG - develops, licenses, and distributes proprietary gaming technology to a global client base. lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Long-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for their return: financial. A stake in another business that is part of operations is operating.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Current portion of long-term debt
lines.why: Borrowed money falling due within a year: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

Human resources : The Company relies on the skills and expertise of its workforce, which includes everyone from the cashiers and odds setters, to the software engineers who maintain and develop its technical infrastructure, customer support personnel, who interface directly with the customers, as well as the compliance and regulatory team customer support representatives.

The Company relies on a combination of trademark, copyright and trade secret laws in the United States and foreign jurisdictions, as well as contractual provisions, to protect its proprietary technology and brands.

The Company also relies on copyright laws to protect the appearance and design of its sites and applications, although to date it has not registered for copyright protection on any particular content.
Our ability to obtain additional capital will depend on our business plans, investor demand, our operating performance, capital markets conditions and other factors.

Section 14 of GA2005 indicates that prize competitions that require entrants to demonstrate a sufficient amount of skill, knowledge or judgment to have a chance of winning are subject to GA2005; however, we rely on the exemption under Schedule 2 of GA2005 by providing participants with a route to free entry to the competitions and are therefore, not subject to GA2005 through the Schedule 2 exemption.

Additionally, the Company’s business depends on the overall demand for gaming platforms, systems and gaming content and other technology offerings, and on the economic health of customers that benefit from the Company’s products.

The Company relies on third-party providers to validate the identity and identify the location of users, and if such providers fail to perform adequately or provide accurate information or we do not maintain business relationships with them, the business, financial condition and results of operations of the Company could be adversely affected.
There is no guarantee that the third-party geolocation and identity verification systems that the Company relies on will perform adequately, or be effective.

The Company relies on geolocation and identity verification systems to ensure that we are in compliance with certain applicable laws and regulations, and any service disruption to those systems would prohibit us from operating and adversely affect our business.
Their third-party geolocation service providers rely on their ability to obtain information necessary to determine geolocation from mobile devices, operating systems, and other sources.

The Company relies on third-party payment processors to process deposits and withdrawals made by users, and if they cannot manage their relationships with such third parties and other payment-related risks, their business, financial condition and results of operations could be adversely affected.
The Company relies on a limited number of third-party payment processors to process deposits and withdrawals made by users.
We also rely on facilities, components, and services supplied by third parties, including data center facilities and cloud storage services.
The Company depends on the services of key personnel to execute its business strategy.
We believe that the future success of the Company will depend on the services of a number of key management and operating personnel.
We rely on third party cloud services and such providers or services have in the past, and may in the future, encounter technical problems and service interruptions.

End-users of our products and services will depend on internet service providers and our system infrastructure (or those of their licensed partners) for access to us or their licensees’ products and services.
The business of the Company depends upon the capacity, reliability and security of the infrastructure owned by third parties over which the Company’s offerings are deployed.
The Company instead depends on these companies to maintain the operational integrity of their connections.
In addition, users depend on real-time communications; outages caused by increased traffic could result in delays and system failures.

Our success may also depend on our ability to obtain trademark protection for the names or symbols under which we market our products and to obtain copyright protection and patent protection of our proprietary technologies, intellectual property, and other game innovations and if the granted patents are challenged, protection may be lost.
We will also rely on trade secrets, ideas, and proprietary know-how.
Our success may depend upon our ability to obtain licenses to use new and existing intellectual property and our ability to retain or expand existing licenses for certain products.
We rely on our management and if they were to leave our company our business plan could be adversely affected.
As a “ controlled company, ” we may elect to rely on some or all of these exemptions, although we do not currently intend to take advantage of any of these exemptions.
The Company relies on AI systems to provide personalized recommendations to users based on historical activity and behavioral data.
These systems depend on the quality, completeness, and representativeness of underlying data.

The payment of dividends in the future will depend upon our results of operations, as well as our short‑term and long‑term cash availability, working capital, working capital needs, and other factors as determined by our Board of Directors.

We encourage investors and others to review our business, results of operations, and financial information in their entirety, not to rely on any single financial measure, and to view non-GAAP measures in conjunction with the most directly comparable GAAP financial measure.
